title: Hysab Kytab v1.1.2
message: Double-Entry Accounting & Ledger Precision: Realigned Khata transfer semantics, counterparty tracking, clean starter profiles for fresh installs, and high-speed in-app updates.
changelog: Refined Double-Entry Khata: Automated counterparty From and To balance synchronization across all loan and settlement workflows
Clean Starter Profiles: Fresh installs launch with clean zero-balance accounts and instant readiness for personal setups
High-Speed In-App Updater: Full-speed downloads powered by native DownloadManager with background notification progress
Dynamic Ledger Integrity: Seamless balance updates and cloud backup synchronization via Google Drive
